Pad Thai (serves 2)

8 oz rice noodles
2 tbsp tamarind paste
2 tbsp fish sauce
1 tbsp palm sugar
1 tbsp lime juice
200g shrimp, deveined
2 eggs
1 cup bean sprouts
3 green onions, sliced
1/4 cup roasted peanuts, crushed
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp vegetable oil

Soak noodles in warm water for 30 minutes until pliable. Drain.
Mix tamarind paste, fish sauce, palm sugar, and lime juice to make the sauce.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat. Sauté garlic for 30 seconds.
Add shrimp, cook 2 minutes until pink. Push to the side.
Crack eggs into the wok, scramble them.
Add noodles and sauce, toss everything together for 2-3 minutes.
Add bean sprouts and green onions, toss for 30 seconds.
Serve topped with crushed peanuts and a lime wedge.
